description: Test suite for TUI (Text User Interface) related functions and behaviors in the openclaw project, covering functions like resolveFinalAssistantText, parseCommand, session key resolution, initial agent inference, disconnect state handling, backspace event deduplication, Ctrl+C actions, and safety shutdown procedures.

methods.name: resolveFinalAssistantText
methods.description: Resolves the final text from assistant response, prioritizing finalText, then streamedText, then falling back to errorMessage with HTTP status.

methods.name: parseCommand
methods.description: Parses slash commands input and normalizes command aliases.

methods.name: getSlashCommands
methods.description: Retrieves list of available slash commands, including gateway text commands.

methods.name: resolveTuiSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the TUI session key based on scope, raw input, agent ID, and main session key.

methods.name: resolveInitialTuiAgentId
methods.description: Infers the initial agent ID for TUI session based on configuration, current working directory, and optional session input.

methods.name: resolveGatewayDisconnectState
methods.description: Determines the disconnection state and provides user guidance based on disconnect reasons.

methods.name: createBackspaceDeduper
methods.description: Creates a deduplication function for backspace events within a specific time window.

methods.name: resolveCtrlCAction
methods.description: Determines the action to take when Ctrl+C is pressed, handling multiple presses within a timing window.

methods.name: isIgnorableTuiStopError
methods.description: Checks if a TUI stop error is ignorable, specifically handle EBADF errors for setRawMode.

methods.name: stopTuiSafely
methods.description: Safely stops the TUI, catching ignorable errors and rethrowing others.

ctags.name: state
ctags.pattern: /^    const state = resolveGatewayDisconnectState("gateway closed (1008): pairing required");$/
